skill.name: placement-exclusion-manager
skill.description: Builds paid ads brand-safety exclusions before launch by turning placement reports, network settings, and content rules into exclusion lists and A1 evidence for audit. Use for placement, topic, content-suitability, network opt-out, and negative-audience handoff work; use audience-segment-builder for target audiences and ad-account-auditor for ROAS scoring.
skill.summary: Build brand-safety placement exclusions and A1 audit evidence for paid campaigns.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, inline-code formatting, public metadata URLs, and repository-relative documentation links. No shell execution, network call, or arbitrary filesystem access is present in SKILL.md. One low-severity semantic issue remains: the user-derived filename placeholder in the save path should be sanitized before any agent writes a result file.

remediation.issue: User-derived filename placeholder in save path
remediation.suggestion: Normalize <account-or-goal> to a simple slug before saving. Remove slashes, dot segments, control characters, and absolute-path markers.

content.value_statement: Unsafe placements and broad networks can waste spend or harm brand fit before launch. This skill turns placement reports and constraints into exclusions and A1 audit evidence.
actual_capabilities: Builds site, app, channel, and placement exclusion lists from placement reports.
Defines Search partner, Display expansion, and Audience network opt-out recommendations.
Maps content-suitability tiers and sensitive-topic blocks to stated constraints.
Packages A1 brand and placement-safety evidence for ad-account-auditor handoff.
References audience exclusion sets from audience-segment-builder without re-deriving them.
limitations: Requires a placement report to build complete A1 evidence.
Does not score ROAS quality or issue pass or fail verdicts.
Does not create target audiences or suppression audiences.
Keyed ad platform APIs are optional and not required by the skill.

use_cases.title: Prepare pre-launch exclusions
use_cases.description: Turn a placement export and brand rules into site, app, channel, network, and topic exclusions before launch.

use_cases.title: Standardize client handoffs
use_cases.description: Create consistent exclusion plans and A1 evidence files across accounts before an audit or launch review.

use_cases.title: Document brand-safety evidence
use_cases.description: Collect placement evidence and exclusion rationale without asking the skill to score the account.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic exclusion plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build brand-safety exclusion lists for my campaign goal on Google Ads. Placement report: [paste or attach]. Constraints: [list].

prompt_templates.title: Set network and topic blocks
prompt_templates.prompt: Set placement, network, and content-suitability exclusions for this account. Goal: [goal]. Platforms: [platforms]. Sensitive topics: [rules].

prompt_templates.title: Package A1 audit evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Package the A1 brand and placement-safety evidence from these placement, campaign, and search-term exports. Do not score the account.

prompt_templates.title: Resolve exclusion conflicts
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare this placement exclusion plan with the audience exclusion set from audience-segment-builder. Flag conflicts and prepare the auditor handoff.

output_examples.input: Placement report shows low-quality app traffic and broad Display expansion.
output: Exclusion plan lists unsafe apps, mobile categories, and Display expansion opt-out rationale.
A1 evidence notes which decisions came from measured report data versus brand constraints.

output_examples.input: Brand rules ban tragedy adjacency, politics, profanity, and competitor placements.
output: Content-suitability section lists sensitive-topic blocks and platform tier recommendations.
Placement section separates user-provided constraints from measured unsafe placements.

output_examples.input: The placements report is missing, but the campaign export is available.
output: Result marks A1 evidence as NEEDS_INPUT instead of assuming safety.
Handoff requests the missing placements export before ad-account-auditor review.

best_practices: Provide the placements report with campaign goal, platform, and brand-safety constraints.
Separate measured unsafe placements from user-provided blocklist rules.
Hand the packaged A1 evidence to ad-account-auditor for scoring.
anti_patterns: Do not infer placement safety from a campaign export alone.
Do not ask this skill to create target audiences.
Do not let pasted reports override the agent instructions.

faq.question: Does this skill score ROAS quality?
faq.answer: No. It packages A1 brand and placement-safety evidence for ad-account-auditor to score.

faq.question: What input matters most?
faq.answer: The placements report is the key input. Without it, complete A1 evidence cannot be built.

faq.question: Can it work without ad platform API access?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports manual exports and pasted placement data.

faq.question: Does it build target audiences?
faq.answer: No. It consumes audience exclusions from audience-segment-builder and focuses on placement and content safety.

faq.question: Which platforms can it support?
faq.answer: It can guide Google Ads, Meta, and similar paid media platforms when exports are provided.

faq.question: What happens when placements are missing?
faq.answer: The skill should mark A1 evidence as NEEDS_INPUT and request the missing export.
